sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: On Monday, we looked at the growing pushback against sprawling AI data centers in communities across America.
sentences.zh: 周一，我们关注了美国各地社区对大型人工智能数据中心日益增长的抵制情绪。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Kevin Roos takes us inside one of the most transformative technologies that infrastructure is enabling.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事凯文·罗斯将带我们深入了解这些基础设施所推动的最具变革性的技术之一。

sentences.en: A new way of programming that may be the biggest development in artificial intelligence since the launch of ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 一种新的编程方式，可能是自ChatGPT发布以来人工智能领域最大的发展。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月18日，星期三。

sentences.en: Okay, so the other day I slacked you, Kevin Roos, my colleague, my friend, the host of the New York Times tech podcast, Hard Fork.
sentences.zh: 好的，前几天我在Slack上找了你，凯文·罗斯，我的同事、我的朋友、《纽约时报》科技播客《Hard Fork》的主持人。

sentences.en: And I asked you, what is vibe coding?
sentences.zh: 我问你，什么是“氛围编程”（vibe coding）？

sentences.en: Because this is a thing I had been hearing about and I had no idea what it was.
sentences.zh: 因为我一直听到这个词，却完全不知道它是什么。

sentences.en: And you answered me roughly in the tone that one might use with their very elderly grandmother, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，你回答我的语气大概就像对待一位年迈的祖母一样。

sentences.en: Fair to say?
sentences.zh: 这么说没错吧？

sentences.en: Well, I am not ageiSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我可没有年龄歧视。

sentences.en: I think people have lots of different levels of comfort with technology.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对技术的适应程度各不相同。

sentences.en: I think my tone of voice was directed at you specifically, Natalie, because I know that you are younger than me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我当时的语气是专门针对你的，娜塔莉，因为我知道你比我年轻。

sentences.en: And so you have no excuse to be this confused by technology.
sentences.zh: 所以你没有理由对技术感到如此困惑。

sentences.en: Yeah, okay, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，确实有道理。

sentences.en: So since then, I did my own research as any young person would do.
sentences.zh: 所以从那以后，我像任何年轻人一样做了自己的研究。

sentences.en: And I've come to the understanding that vibe coding is, in fact, very important.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，“氛围编程”实际上非常重要。

sentences.en: It appears to be using AI in a way that is truly revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 它似乎是一种真正具有革命性的人工智能使用方式。

sentences.en: And I do think that I cannot possibly be the only one who has not caught up to this.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，我不可能是一个还没跟上这个潮流的人。

sentences.en: And so I want to ask you to just start by laying out the basics for those of us who aren't there yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你先为我们这些还没入门的人讲解一下基础知识。

sentences.en: What is vibe coding?
sentences.zh: 什么是“氛围编程”？

sentences.en: So vibe coding is a term that was coined about a year ago by a guy named Andre Karpathy, who's a former programmer at OpenAI, very well-known out here in Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: “氛围编程”这个词大约是一年前由安德烈·卡帕西（Andre Karpathy）提出的，他是OpenAI的前程序员，在硅谷非常出名。

sentences.en: And he was describing this thing that he was doing using these new AI coding tools,
sentences.zh: 他当时是在描述自己使用这些新型AI编程工具时做的事情，

sentences.en: which is that instead of learning a programming language and writing the code line by line by himself,
sentences.zh: 那就是他不再需要学习编程语言并亲手一行一行地写代码，

sentences.en: he would just sort of let the program write the code for him and build software that way.
sentences.zh: 而是让程序替他写代码，并以此构建软件。

sentences.en: Let the vibes do the work.
sentences.zh: 让氛围来完成工作。

sentences.en: Let the vibes do the work, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，让氛围来完成工作。

sentences.en: And suddenly, for the first time, about a year ago, you didn't have to know how to code to build software.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，大约在一年前，你不需要懂编程也能构建软件了。

sentences.en: You could just use these tools.
sentences.zh: 你只需要使用这些工具。

sentences.en: They would help you along the way, and you could just kind of oversee them as they worked.
sentences.zh: 它们会在过程中为你提供帮助，你只需要在它们工作时进行监督即可。

sentences.en: So what does that actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么这到底是什么样子的呢？

sentences.en: You experimented with it.
sentences.zh: 你尝试过它。

sentences.en: What did that do for you?
sentences.zh: 它为你带来了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I tried vibe coding about a year ago when this term first emerged.
sentences.zh: 是的，大约一年前这个词刚出现时，我就尝试过“氛围编程”。

sentences.en: And I would build these little test tools for myself.
sentences.zh: 我为自己构建了一些小的测试工具。

sentences.en: I built an app called Lunchbox Buddy, which was basically a way to help me pack my son's lunch
sentences.zh: 我做了一个叫“午餐盒伙伴”（Lunchbox Buddy）的应用程序，它基本上能帮我打包儿子的午餐，

sentences.en: by just taking a photo of whatever was in my fridge and giving it to this tool and saying,
sentences.zh: 方法就是拍一张冰箱里有什么的照片，然后发给这个工具，问它：

sentences.en: like, what are the different combinations of things I could put in this four-compartment lunchbox?
sentences.zh: “在这个四格午餐盒里，我可以组合出哪些不同的搭配？”

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So useful.
sentences.zh: 太实用了。

sentences.en: I want it.
sentences.zh: 我也想要一个。

sentences.en: Yeah, I built some other stuff, too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我还做了一些其他的东西。

sentences.en: But honestly, it was kind of clunky.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，它有点笨重。

sentences.en: The tools, basically, you still needed to know a little bit about programming to be able to do this.
sentences.zh: 这些工具基本上还是需要你懂一点编程才能使用。

sentences.en: And they were pretty buggy.
sentences.zh: 而且它们有很多漏洞。

sentences.en: I tried to build some stuff to help me sort through my emails, and it couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我试着做了一些东西来帮我整理邮件，但它做不到。

sentences.en: It was mostly useful to professional programmers.
sentences.zh: 它主要还是对专业程序员有用。

sentences.en: And it doesn't stay that way, I'd imagine, because here we are talking about it as something that is revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 我想它不会一直停留在那个阶段，因为我们现在正把它当作一种革命性的东西来讨论。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the big innovation between last year and now is what is called agentic coding.
sentences.zh: 去年到现在的重大创新被称为“代理式编程”（agentic coding）。

sentences.en: Agentic coding is basically just a fancy way of saying an AI system that can do much more of the process autonomously.
sentences.zh: “代理式编程”其实就是一种高级说法，指AI系统可以更自主地完成大部分流程。

sentences.en: So you still do have to, like, have the idea for what you want to build.
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要有想要构建什么的想法。

sentences.en: But then with these new tools, you can just sort of give them a project, and they can make a plan.
sentences.zh: 但有了这些新工具，你只需要给它们一个项目，它们就能制定计划。

sentences.en: They can decide what programming languages they want to use.
sentences.zh: 它们可以决定使用什么编程语言。

sentences.en: They can even create their own little team of agents and say, okay, this agent's going to go off and do the research.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至可以创建自己的小代理团队，并说：好吧，这个代理去负责调研，

sentences.en: This agent's going to build the website.
sentences.zh: 这个代理去构建网站，

sentences.en: This agent's going to test it.
sentences.zh: 这个代理去进行测试。

sentences.en: And so you sort of have a little team of robots working for you to do whatever task you've given it.
sentences.zh: 所以你就像拥有了一个为你工作的小型机器人团队，来执行你交给它的任何任务。

sentences.en: My dream, a team of robots.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想，一个机器人团队。

sentences.en: Just sketch out why that's a big deal, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 凯文，简单概括一下为什么这很重要。

sentences.en: Well, because these models are getting much better very quickly, and they are now able to do the kinds of tasks that would take humans hours or sometimes even days to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为这些模型正在迅速变得更好，它们现在能够完成人类需要数小时甚至数天才能完成的任务。

sentences.en: And so they are working their way up into the entry-level functions in a lot of white-collar industries.
sentences.zh: 所以它们正在进入许多白领行业的入门级职能中。

sentences.en: The models themselves are also getting much better.
sentences.zh: 模型本身也在变得更好。

sentences.en: They're not hallucinating as much as they used to.
sentences.zh: 它们不像以前那样容易产生幻觉了。

sentences.en: They're not making as many silly mistakes as they used to.
sentences.zh: 它们犯的愚蠢错误也没以前那么多了。

sentences.en: They are doing better at things like reasoning and solving complex math and science problems than they used to.
sentences.zh: 它们在推理、解决复杂的数学和科学问题方面比以前做得更好。

sentences.en: So sort of across the board, these things are getting better at a pace that is surprising even the people who are building them.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，这些东西进步的速度甚至让开发它们的人都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to ask you about the transformational potential of that, about the impact on jobs.
sentences.zh: 我想问你关于它的变革潜力，以及对就业的影响。

sentences.en: But first, just tell me at a really practical level, where do you see these new tools?
sentences.zh: 但首先，请从非常实际的层面告诉我，你在哪里看到了这些新工具？

sentences.en: Like, what or who is driving this agentic phase?
sentences.zh: 比如，是什么或谁在推动这个“代理式”阶段？

sentences.en: So this is largely being driven by a handful of companies that are sort of the leaders in this AI race.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上是由少数几家在AI竞赛中处于领先地位的公司推动的。

sentences.en: So one of them is OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是ChatGPT的制造商OpenAI。

sentences.en: They have a new agentic coding system called Codex.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个名为Codex的新型代理式编程系统。

sentences.en: I have been using CloudCode, which is made by Anthropic, another AI company.
sentences.zh: 我一直在使用Anthropic（另一家AI公司）开发的CloudCode。

sentences.en: And these are the tools that have come out just in the past couple of months that have people feeling like things are really accelerating.
sentences.zh: 这些工具都是在过去几个月里才推出的，让人们觉得事情真的在加速发展。

sentences.en: CloudCode sort of blew up.
sentences.zh: CloudCode算是彻底火了。

sentences.en: Millions of people have been using it.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的人一直在使用它。

sentences.en: They are doing increasingly complex tasks with them.
sentences.zh: 他们正在用它完成越来越复杂的任务。

sentences.en: People are using these in their jobs in the software industry.
sentences.zh: 人们在软件行业的工作中都在使用这些工具。

sentences.en: And what's really changed is that if you talk to people at the big AI companies who used to program, who used to write code by hand, they'll say, I don't write any code anymore.
sentences.zh: 真正改变的是，如果你和那些曾经编程、曾经亲手写代码的大型AI公司的人交谈，他们会说：我再也不写代码了。

sentences.en: I basically supervise this team of agents, and I kind of orchestrate them and set them off toward tasks.
sentences.zh: 我基本上是在监督这个代理团队，我指挥它们并让它们去执行任务。

sentences.en: And then I go get lunch, and I come back, and the work is done.
sentences.zh: 然后我去吃午饭，回来时工作就完成了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to understand this.
sentences.zh: 我想理解这一点。

sentences.en: I want to understand the story of this.
sentences.zh: 我想了解这个故事。

sentences.en: I think we should pick one, and it sounds like CloudCode has been the one that's been blowing up.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该选一个例子，听起来CloudCode就是那个火起来的工具。

sentences.en: So tell me the story of this model.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我这个模型的故事吧。

sentences.en: How did it start?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: How did it get created?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么被创造出来的？

sentences.en: So this app, CloudCode, started as a side project.
sentences.zh: 这个应用CloudCode最初只是一个副项目。

sentences.en: Basically, an engineer at Anthropic named Boris Cherny had an idea.
sentences.zh: 基本上，Anthropic的一位工程师鲍里斯·切尔尼（Boris Cherny）有一个想法。

sentences.en: He was trying to sort of get a sense of what Cloud Anthropic's chatbot could do.
sentences.zh: 他当时想了解Anthropic的聊天机器人Cloud到底能做什么。

sentences.en: So he said, well, what if I just give it my computer?
sentences.zh: 于是他说，好吧，如果我把我的电脑交给它会怎样？

sentences.en: What if I install Cloud inside the Terminal app, which is the app that you use to write code and interface with your computer if you're a programmer?
sentences.zh: 如果我把Cloud安装在终端（Terminal）应用里会怎样？如果你是程序员，这就是你用来写代码和与电脑交互的程序。

sentences.en: And what would happen if I just set Cloud loose inside my computer with a bunch of tools?
sentences.zh: 如果我让Cloud在我的电脑里带着一堆工具自由运行，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Like, give it the ability to write scripts, to create files, to organize things, to debug code.
sentences.zh: 比如，给它编写脚本、创建文件、整理东西、调试代码的能力。

sentences.en: And he starts seeing something really interesting happening around the office.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始看到办公室周围发生了一些非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: His colleagues are starting to use this tool to do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 他的同事们开始使用这个工具来完成他们的工作。

sentences.en: They're starting to program with it.
sentences.zh: 他们开始用它编程。

sentences.en: It started with the engineers.
sentences.zh: 起初是工程师们开始使用。

sentences.en: They're saying this is really great for coding.
sentences.zh: 他们说这对编程真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: At first, it's maybe 20% of their engineers, and then it's 40%, and now all of them are using it.
sentences.zh: 起初可能只有20%的工程师在用，然后是40%，现在他们所有人都在用。

sentences.en: But it's also being used by people who are not professional programmers.
sentences.zh: 但它也被非专业程序员的人使用。

sentences.en: People in marketing and sales and finance are using this not to just build little apps, but to automate parts of their jobs.
sentences.zh: 市场、销售和财务部门的人都在用它，不仅仅是为了构建小应用，而是为了自动化他们工作的一部分。

sentences.en: So it's like really catching on way beyond, you know, the technical people, like normies are using it.
sentences.zh: 所以它真的在技术人员之外流行开了，你知道，普通人也在用它。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What people have discovered is that it can do lots of stuff.
sentences.zh: 人们发现它可以做很多事情。

sentences.en: It can automate your email.
sentences.zh: 它可以自动化你的邮件。

sentences.en: It can create dashboards for things.
sentences.zh: 它可以为各种事物创建仪表板。

sentences.en: It can reorganize the files on your computer.
sentences.zh: 它可以重新整理你电脑上的文件。

sentences.en: It's sort of like you just have a computer that can use a computer now.
sentences.zh: 这就像是你现在拥有了一台会使用电脑的电脑。

sentences.en: This is starting to blow my mind, but I want to see it in action.
sentences.zh: 这开始让我感到震惊了，但我希望能亲眼看看。

sentences.en: Can we make something together?
sentences.zh: 我们可以一起做点什么吗？

sentences.en: Can you make something for me?
sentences.zh: 你能为我做点什么吗？

sentences.en: How does this work?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Okay, I would love to show you.
sentences.zh: 好的，我很乐意展示给你看。

sentences.en: So what I'll do is I will share my screen here.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在共享我的屏幕。

sentences.en: I'm excited and a little scared.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋，但也有一点害怕。

sentences.en: Don't be scared.
sentences.zh: 别害怕。

sentences.en: It'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 没事的。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is the Terminal app.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是终端应用。

sentences.en: Have you spent much time in the Terminal app on your computer?
sentences.zh: 你在电脑上的终端应用里花过很多时间吗？

sentences.en: The answer is not going to surprise you.
sentences.zh: 答案不会让你感到惊讶的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Okay, so I had not either before I started using Cloud Code.
sentences.zh: 好的，我在开始使用CloudCode之前也没有。

sentences.en: Okay, this looks technical though, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 好的，但这看起来很专业，凯文。

sentences.en: Can I just say this is not my chat GPT window.
sentences.zh: 我可以直说吗，这不是我的ChatGPT窗口。

sentences.en: No, this looks like hardcore programming things.
sentences.zh: 不，这看起来像是硬核编程的东西。

sentences.en: And I think the interface is what has made a lot of people feel like this is a tool that they can't use because they don't write code.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这种界面让很多人觉得这是一个他们无法使用的工具，因为他们不会写代码。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I will just say I do not write code.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想说，我不会写代码。

sentences.en: I am not a coder.
sentences.zh: 我不是程序员。

sentences.en: You're closer to me than them, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 你是说你比他们更接近我。

sentences.en: I am much closer to you than them.
sentences.zh: 我离你比离他们近多了。

sentences.en: So, okay, here we are.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: We're inside Cloud Code.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在 Cloud Code 里。

sentences.en: And I'm just going to give it a prompt.
sentences.zh: 我打算给它一个指令。

sentences.en: I'm going to say build a website for my colleague, Natalie Kittrow-F.
sentences.zh: 我要说：为我的同事 Natalie Kittrow-F 建立一个网站。

sentences.en: And I noticed, Natalie, that you don't have a personal website, at least that I could see.
sentences.zh: 我注意到，Natalie，你好像没有个人网站，至少我没看到。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Do you have one?
sentences.zh: 你有吗？

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: I'm kind of giving over my identity to the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我算是把我的个人身份信息都交给《纽约时报》了。

sentences.en: No, see, you need one.

sentences.en: Kevin, I have to just acknowledge that it is honestly an amazing feeling to see this AI agent at work.
sentences.zh: Kevin，我必须承认，看到这个 AI 智能体在工作，感觉真的太神奇了。

sentences.en: It's probably the first time that I have felt awe at this technology since ChatGPT came out.
sentences.zh: 这大概是我自 ChatGPT 问世以来，第一次对这项技术感到敬畏。

sentences.en: It's been a really long time, and there is something a little bit unnerving about it.
sentences.zh: 已经很久没有这种感觉了，而且它确实让人有点不安。

sentences.en: And so I just wonder, for you, what do you make of this moment?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，对你来说，你怎么看待这一刻？

sentences.en: What do you make of this change that we're seeing in these tools?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看待我们正在这些工具中看到的这种变化？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this is a big deal in the world of AI.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是 AI 领域的一件大事。

sentences.en: This is something that people inside the AI industry have been saying is coming for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这是 AI 行业内的人很久以来一直预言会发生的事情。

sentences.en: But until recently, people couldn't really see it for themselves or try it for themselves.
sentences.zh: 但直到最近，人们才真正亲眼看到或亲身体验到它。

sentences.en: And, you know, ChatGPT has been around for three years now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，ChatGPT 已经出现三年了。

sentences.en: And for most people, the novelty is sort of wearing off.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，新鲜感已经开始消退了。

sentences.en: You know, it's a fancy Google.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它就像一个高级版的谷歌。

sentences.en: You can get a meal plan.
sentences.zh: 你可以用它制定饮食计划。

sentences.en: You can sort of give it some questions.
sentences.zh: 你可以问它一些问题。

sentences.en: It can help you write your emails or memos or things like that.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮你写邮件、备忘录之类的东西。

sentences.en: But it doesn't sort of shock you anymore.
sentences.zh: 但它已经不会再让你感到震惊了。

sentences.en: This feels different to me and I think to a lot of other people when you can actually build something useful without knowing how to write code.
sentences.zh: 对我以及许多其他人来说，当你能在不懂编程的情况下真正构建出有用的东西时，感觉就完全不同了。

sentences.en: And I think this is what people think is the thing that's going to take AI from just kind of being a fancier Google to something that genuinely changes how people work.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是人们认为会让 AI 从一个“更高级的谷歌”转变为真正改变人们工作方式的东西。

sentences.en: When you say that this is something that the tech companies have been saying is coming for a long time, what is the it that is coming?
sentences.zh: 当你提到这是科技公司长期以来一直预言会发生的事情时，这个“它”到底是什么？

sentences.en: What makes it special?
sentences.zh: 是什么让它如此特别？

sentences.en: Is it just the complexity of the stuff it can do or is it the utility of it?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为它能做的事情的复杂性，还是它的实用性？

sentences.en: I think it's the utility, but it's also the economic value.
sentences.zh: 我认为是实用性，但也有经济价值。

sentences.en: This kind of agentic system can actually do work.
sentences.zh: 这种代理系统真的可以干活。

sentences.en: It can do tasks.
sentences.zh: 它可以执行任务。

sentences.en: It can perform things that humans would have had to do by hand.
sentences.zh: 它可以完成人类原本必须亲手去做的事情。

sentences.en: So it is sort of a step in the direction of making these things actually kind of members of the workforce in some sense where you could have a company with some human employees and then a whole bunch of AI agents doing tasks.
sentences.zh: 所以，这在某种意义上是让这些东西成为劳动力成员的一步，你可以拥有一家既有员工又有大量 AI 智能体在执行任务的公司。

sentences.en: OK, let's talk about that, because obviously when we're talking about economic value,
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈这个，因为显然当我们谈论经济价值时，

sentences.en: what that presumably means for the people that run these companies is lowering labor costs by potentially eliminating jobs.
sentences.zh: 这对于经营这些公司的人来说，大概意味着通过裁员来降低劳动力成本。

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's the big question is will this just help people at work?
sentences.zh: 是的，所以最大的问题是，这真的能帮助人们工作吗？

sentences.en: Will this kind of agentic coding tool make people faster and more efficient and more productive and give them a new powerful tool in their toolkit or will it start to replace people?
sentences.zh: 这种代理式编程工具是会让人们工作得更快、更高效、更有生产力，并为他们的工具箱增添一个强大的新工具，还是会开始取代人类？

sentences.en: We are starting to see in the data some signs that this kind of tool is maybe displacing young software developers.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在数据中看到一些迹象，表明这种工具可能正在取代年轻的软件开发人员。

sentences.en: So there was a study from Stanford recently that looked at payroll records and found that employment for young software engineers, just people who are early in their careers,
sentences.zh: 最近斯坦福大学的一项研究查看了工资记录，发现年轻软件工程师的就业率——也就是那些职业生涯早期的人，

sentences.en: has dropped about 20 percent from its peak in 2022.
sentences.zh: 比 2022 年的峰值下降了约 20%。

sentences.en: So companies that used to hire five or 10 people to write code for them may only need one or two now with a bunch of AI tools.
sentences.zh: 所以，以前需要雇佣 5 到 10 个人来写代码的公司，现在可能只需要一两个人配合一堆 AI 工具就够了。

sentences.en: Can I ask, we were pointing to issues with my beautiful website.
sentences.zh: 我可以问一下吗，我们刚才指出了我那个漂亮网站的一些问题。

sentences.en: How good is this stuff?
sentences.zh: 这东西到底有多好用？

sentences.en: I mean, can it debug itself?
sentences.zh: 我是说，它能自我调试吗？

sentences.en: Because I guess I'm seeing that there is also a lot of doubt and skepticism that you can really do this only with an AI tool at this point.
sentences.zh: 因为我感觉现在大家还是有很多怀疑和顾虑，觉得仅靠 AI 工具真的能做到这一点。

sentences.en: So, well, coding is an interesting test ground for this because in some sense it is very verifiable.
sentences.zh: 嗯，编程是一个很好的测试领域，因为在某种意义上，它是非常可验证的。

sentences.en: The code either runs or it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 代码要么能运行，要么不能。

sentences.en: And so in some sense it's very easy to tell.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种角度来看，判断起来非常容易。

sentences.en: I mean, the website we built you, it works.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们为你构建的那个网站，它确实能用。

sentences.en: You can go visit it on the web.
sentences.zh: 你可以在网上访问它。

sentences.en: It has a playable video game inside of it.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一个可以玩的游戏。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, yes, there are a lot of software engineers who are still saying these coding agents, they're not perfect.
sentences.zh: 所以，确实有很多软件工程师还在说，这些编程智能体并不完美。

sentences.en: You still kind of need to hold their hands and oversee them if you want to get really useful code that you could, like, deploy inside of a big business.
sentences.zh: 如果你想得到真正有用、可以部署到大企业里的代码，你还是得手把手地指导和监督它们。

sentences.en: But that is maybe temporary because they're improving at a very rapid rate.
sentences.zh: 但这可能只是暂时的，因为它们进步的速度非常快。

sentences.en: And we're seeing that some of the things that these tools couldn't do even a few months ago, it's now doing in ways that are correct and useful.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，这些工具几个月前还做不到的一些事情，现在已经能正确且高效地完成了。

sentences.en: Well, can you just tell me quickly, like, what's making this improve so quickly?
sentences.zh: 那你能不能简单告诉我，是什么让它进步得这么快？

sentences.en: So, part of it is just that the models themselves, the things that are sort of underneath tools like CloudCode, are just getting better very rapidly.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于模型本身，也就是像 CloudCode 这类工具底层的模型，正在飞速进化。

sentences.en: And part of that is because they're being trained on more coding data.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为它们接受了更多编程数据的训练。

sentences.en: So, they're sort of improving over time.
sentences.zh: 所以，它们在不断进步。

sentences.en: The other really interesting and really important thing that is starting to happen is that these AI tools are building versions of themselves.
sentences.zh: 另一件非常有趣且重要的事情正在发生，那就是这些 AI 工具正在构建自己的版本。

sentences.en: They are starting to improve themselves.
sentences.zh: 它们开始自我改进了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: So, OpenAI's latest coding model, which is called GPT 5.3 Codex, was used to help build itself.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 最新的编程模型 GPT 5.3 Codex，就是被用来辅助构建它自身的。

sentences.en: Early versions of the model were used to make changes to the training runs for later versions.
sentences.zh: 该模型的早期版本被用于调整后续版本的训练过程。

sentences.en: So, this is happening across all of the leading AI companies right now, which is that you have these systems which can build websites,
sentences.zh: 所以，现在所有领先的 AI 公司都在发生这种情况，即这些系统不仅能构建网站，

sentences.en: which can automate certain financial or legal tasks.
sentences.zh: 还能自动化处理某些财务或法律任务。

sentences.en: They can also help train AI models.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至能帮助训练 AI 模型。

sentences.en: And so, we're starting to see…
sentences.zh: 所以，我们开始看到……

sentences.en: So, AI models making AI models, just to be clear about what we're saying here.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，AI 模型在制造 AI 模型，为了明确起见，我们说的是这个。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is that scary to you?
sentences.zh: 这让你感到害怕吗？

sentences.en: Because it gives me the vibe of a sci-fi reality.
sentences.zh: 因为它给我一种科幻现实的感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a sort of scenario that we've heard about in science fiction for years, where you have AIs that are becoming increasingly capable.
sentences.zh: 是的，这正是我们在科幻小说中听过多年的场景，AI 变得越来越强大。

sentences.en: They're building better and better AIs.
sentences.zh: 它们正在构建越来越好的 AI。

sentences.en: Within the AI community, there's this idea, this phrase of the intelligence explosion,
sentences.zh: 在 AI 社区里，有一个概念，叫“智能爆炸”，

sentences.en: which is when you have these systems that are doing what's known as recursive self-improvement, building better and better versions of themselves.
sentences.zh: 也就是当这些系统进行所谓的“递归自我改进”，构建出越来越强的自身版本时。

sentences.en: And so, that is one possibility,
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一种可能性，

sentences.en: that these systems just start to accelerate their improvements to the point where they are sort of doing all of this autonomously without human involvement.
sentences.zh: 即这些系统开始加速自我改进，直到它们在没有人类参与的情况下自主完成这一切。

sentences.en: Now, there are some people who think this is still a far-fetched scenario, but just look at the trajectory.
sentences.zh: 现在，有些人认为这还很遥远，但看看这个发展轨迹吧。

sentences.en: I mean, a year ago, you had these very clunky AI vibe coding tools.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一年前，你用的还是那种非常笨拙的“氛围编程”工具。

sentences.en: Now, they're running autonomously for sometimes hours at a time.
sentences.zh: 现在，它们可以连续自主运行数小时。

sentences.en: They can build and maintain real software, and they're starting to help build the next versions of themselves.
sentences.zh: 它们能构建和维护真正的软件，并且开始帮助构建它们的下一代版本。

sentences.en: So, I think we are right to be paying attention to this, and I think it's irresponsible to sugarcoat what's happening.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们关注这一点是正确的，而且我认为粉饰现实是不负责任的。

sentences.en: I have to say, for the companies and for the people that have been involved in AI, this also has to really be a kind of proof-of-concept moment for them,
sentences.zh: 我必须说，对于那些参与 AI 开发的公司和个人来说，这一定也是一个“概念验证”的关键时刻，

sentences.en: because there has been so much skepticism about AI over the last year.
sentences.zh: 因为过去一年里，人们对 AI 有太多的怀疑。

sentences.en: A lot of fear about frothiness in the market, about whether we're in a bubble, about whether AI is really going to live up to its potential.
sentences.zh: 对市场泡沫的恐惧，对 AI 是否真的能发挥其潜力的质疑。

sentences.en: And what you've described is a transformative tool that can be incredibly useful, and with that, the potential for real job loss.
sentences.zh: 而你所描述的是一种变革性的工具，它极其有用，但也伴随着真正的失业风险。

sentences.en: So, any way you slice it, this is AI doing what they said it probably would.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你怎么看，这都是 AI 在实现人们预期的功能。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, I don't blame people for questioning last year whether we were in an AI bubble.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我不怪人们去年质疑我们是否处于 AI 泡沫之中。

sentences.en: I think most people up to that point had only used things like ChatGPT, which are, you know, very capable on their own,
sentences.zh: 我认为在那之前，大多数人只用过 ChatGPT 之类的东西，它们本身确实非常强大，

sentences.en: but I can understand why people would look at that and then look at the billions of dollars being spent on data centers and infrastructure and think like, okay,
sentences.zh: 但我能理解为什么人们看到这些，再看看在数据中心和基础设施上投入的数十亿美元，会觉得：好吧，

sentences.en: isn't this a little bit much?
sentences.zh: 这是否有点过头了？

sentences.en: But the bet that these AI companies were making is that you could actually turn this stuff into useful tools that would be able to do real valuable work in the economy.
sentences.zh: 但这些 AI 公司押注的是，你可以真正把这些东西变成有用的工具，在经济中创造真正的价值。

sentences.en: And I think we are starting to see that bet pay off.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们开始看到这个赌注正在获得回报。

sentences.en: Kevin, I think it's worth pausing here for a moment.
sentences.zh: 凯文，我觉得这里值得停下来思考一下。

sentences.en: Like, it's very easy to talk about job loss from all this in the abstract.
sentences.zh: 抽象地谈论失业很容易。

sentences.en: But at a practical level, if a whole class of workers just lose their jobs, if those jobs cease to exist, we'd be talking about a pretty massive impact on the economy writ large.
sentences.zh: 但在现实层面，如果整整一类工人失去了工作，如果这些岗位不复存在，那对整个经济的影响将是巨大的。

sentences.en: And, I mean, this could hypothetically just be the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 而且，这可能仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: If agents like these can do other forms of work, you could see many more jobs wiped out.
sentences.zh: 如果像这样的智能体能完成其他形式的工作，你可能会看到更多岗位被淘汰。

sentences.en: So I just want to ask, how likely is it really that these tools create that kind of job loss?
sentences.zh: 所以我只想问，这些工具造成这种失业的可能性到底有多大？

sentences.en: And what are the AI companies saying about it?
sentences.zh: AI 公司对此是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So I'll answer the first part, which is that I don't know how likely it is.
sentences.zh: 我先回答第一个问题，我不知道可能性有多大。

sentences.en: I have intuitions and guesses, but no one really knows how this is going to go.
sentences.zh: 我有直觉和猜测，但没人真正知道未来会怎样。

sentences.en: It could be that there's a short-term spike in the demand for software engineers because everyone's building new kinds of software and they need people to manage it all.
sentences.zh: 可能软件工程师的需求会短期激增，因为每个人都在构建新型软件，需要人来管理这一切。

sentences.en: And it could be that these tools just never wipe out millions of jobs en masse.
sentences.zh: 也可能这些工具永远不会大规模淘汰数百万个工作岗位。

sentences.en: But the AI companies and the people who run the companies are increasingly worried about this.
sentences.zh: 但 AI 公司及其负责人对此越来越担忧。

sentences.en: So Dario Amadei, who's the CEO of Anthropic, which makes Claude,
sentences.zh: Anthropic（Claude 的开发商）的首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）

sentences.en: has warned that he believes that AI could potentially eliminate half of all entry-level white-collar jobs within the next five years.
sentences.zh: 曾警告说，他认为 AI 可能在未来五年内消除一半的入门级白领工作。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that could be wildly off.
sentences.zh: 这个预测可能偏差很大。

sentences.en: But even if it were partially true, even if it were 10% or 20%, that would still be a massive change to the labor market and to the lives of millions of people.
sentences.zh: 但即使只有部分成真，哪怕是 10% 或 20%，对劳动力市场和数百万人的生活来说，依然是巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's something deeply unsettling about all of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，这一切确实让人深感不安。

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: And I myself feel very uncertain about this.
sentences.zh: 我自己也对此感到非常不确定。

sentences.en: And I think there are a lot of people in the tech industry who are very excited about these tools because it's letting them build a bunch of stuff very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我认为科技行业里有很多人对这些工具感到兴奋，因为这让他们能飞速构建各种东西。

sentences.en: But as I'm hearing from more people in white-collar knowledge work fields, they're just very anxious right now.
sentences.zh: 但随着我从更多白领知识工作者那里听到的反馈，他们现在非常焦虑。

sentences.en: People are really uncertain.
sentences.zh: 人们真的很迷茫。

sentences.en: They don't know if the skills they're building are obsolete.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道自己掌握的技能是否已经过时。

sentences.en: College students don't know what they should be studying so they can get a job after they graduate.
sentences.zh: 大学生不知道该学什么才能在毕业后找到工作。

sentences.en: People are really getting nervous about how quickly this technology is improving and the possibility that it could make the future look very different.
sentences.zh: 人们对这项技术进步的速度，以及它可能让未来变得面目全非的可能性感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: Okay, and I want to ask about that future.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想问问关于那个未来的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, are we on a runaway train?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们是在一辆失控的列车上吗？

sentences.en: The speed with which this is changing feels hard to even capture, honestly.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这种变化的速度快到难以捕捉。

sentences.en: And I wonder, if you think about the progress made over one year, what's the next year?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，如果你回顾过去一年的进展，明年会怎样？

sentences.en: What can we expect?
sentences.zh: 我们可以期待什么？

sentences.en: I mean, my honest prediction is that a year from now, these agentic tools will be dramatically better, right?
sentences.zh: 我诚实的预测是，一年后，这些智能体工具会变得极其强大，对吧？

sentences.en: They'll handle big, complex probleMs.
sentences.zh: 它们将能处理大型、复杂的问题。

sentences.en: You won't have to hold their hand as much.
sentences.zh: 你不需要再手把手地指导它们了。

sentences.en: They will become full-fledged members of the workforce.
sentences.zh: 它们将成为劳动力大军中成熟的一员。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of companies will still do things the old way because institutions are very slow to change, as we know.
sentences.zh: 当然，很多公司仍会沿用旧方式，因为我们知道，机构的改变非常缓慢。

sentences.en: But there will be this sort of new kind of company that is emerging with AI work at the center of it.
sentences.zh: 但会出现一种以 AI 工作为核心的新型公司。

sentences.en: And I think that's going to be a really fast-growing part of the economy.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是经济中增长最快的部分。

sentences.en: I think the job market impacts that we're starting to see hints of today will become much clearer a year from now.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们今天初见端倪的就业市场影响，一年后会变得清晰得多。

sentences.en: But, honestly, I lose a lot of visibility myself.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，我自己也看不清了。

sentences.en: I mean, I have stopped trying to predict more than about six months out because that's about as far as I can see right now.
sentences.zh: 我已经不再尝试预测超过六个月后的事情了，因为那是我目前能看到的极限。

sentences.en: I would not have predicted a year ago when vibe coding first came into my consciousness that it was going to be capable of doing all of this today.
sentences.zh: 一年前，当“氛围编程”刚进入我的视野时，我绝不会预测到它今天能做到这一切。

sentences.en: So, I think the most we can say right now is that these tools are getting better at a very fast and accelerating rate.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们现在能说的就是，这些工具正以极快且不断加速的速度进步。

sentences.en: And that they keep doing things that are surprising and useful.
sentences.zh: 而且它们不断做出令人惊讶且有用的事情。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of unknowns about what that will mean for the future of human work.
sentences.zh: 对于这对人类工作的未来意味着什么，还有很多未知数。

sentences.en: Kevin, one of my favorite humans, thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 凯文，我最喜欢的人之一，非常感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.zh: 我们还要感谢帮你构建那个漂亮网站的 Claude。

sentences.en: Thank you, Claude.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Claude。

sentences.zh: 它一直是个好机器人。

sentences.en: He has.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。
